mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may potentiate progesterone's CNS effects and there is theoretical risk of serotonergic modulation, though progesterone is not primarily serotonergic; progesterone may also affect hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS depression, mood changes, or hypertensive episodes; use combination cautiously and ensure adequate clinical monitoring; consider alternative antidepressant if possible.
